result.generation_response: The document outlines the 2014-15 budget projections for VAMED IVI. CINOLETON CRARTEN, detailing funding sources and expenditures. Total revenue is $5,461,160, sourced from state/local per-pupil funding ($4,346,160), federal grants/Title I/IDEA ($805,000 + $185,000 ERATE/LA-4), and donations ($50,000). Key expenditures include: Salaries (Code 100) totaling $2,709,910 covering administration, instructional/non-instructional staff; Employee Benefits (Code 200) totaling $668,711.57 for health insurance, Social Security, Medicare, retirement, and disability; Purchased Professional Services (Code 300) totaling $271,609 for legal, auditing, and management services; Purchased Property Services (Code 400) totaling $995,359 for utilities, facility use, repairs, and maintenance; and Other Purchased Services (Code 500) totaling $640,475 for transportation, insurance, food service, travel, and communications.

The James M. Singleton Charter School 2014-15 Budget Projections outline key expenditures across two categories. Supplies (Object Code 600) total $95,095.43, covering materials and supplies ($42,295.43), food & commodities ($2,500), books and periodicals ($35,300), and other/custodial supplies ($15,000). Other Use of Funds (Object Code 900) total $80,000, including depreciation ($15,000) and indirect cost ($65,000), with no contingency allocated. Total expenditures amount to $5,461,160.00 with no budget difference reported.

The James Singleton Charter School Program Budget Assumptions for 2012-2013 outline key financial and operational parameters: student enrollment is 520 (MFP count) plus 40 LA4 students; MFP allocation is $8,358 per pupil (state and local), pending legislative approval; LA4 allocation is $5,532.50 per pupil, pending state approval; teacher-to-student ratio is 22:1; and federal funds (Title I, Title II, IDEA B) total $805,000, representing 90% of the 2013-14 allocation pending BESE approval, with a school calendar of 182–192 instructional days.
